events.headline: Brent crude tops $107/bbl and WTI hits $102 as Strait of Hormuz conflict grinds on, driving a 4th straight down day for US stocks

US military launches fresh strikes on Iranian targets near the Strait of Hormuz after tanker attacks; oil spikes but defense primes (Lockheed, RTX, Northrop) slide as the escalation trade is already priced in
August CPI comes in hot: core CPI +0.3% m/m (above the 0.2% forecast), core YoY 2.4% in line, headline +0.4% m/m / 3.4% YoY, raising the odds of a Fed rate hike at the Sept 17-18 FOMC meeting
30-year Treasury yield hits 5.373%, its highest since 2007, as oil-driven inflation fears and hawkish Fed rhetoric pressure bonds
